```java
    public static String extractJsonDataFromResponse(String rawResponse) {

        for (String line : lines) {

                jsonData = line.substring(5);
                break;
            }
        }
        if (jsonData == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to parse the returned content, data field is missing.");
        }
        return jsonData;

    public static Iterator<String> invokeLlmStream(HttpContext context, String model, String question)
        throws ServiceException {
        String param = JSON.toJSONString(new ChatCompletionsReq(true,
            model,
            Collections.singletonList(new ChatJobQuestion("user", question))));
        RestfulParametes restfulParametes = new RestfulParametes();
        restfulParametes.setRawData(param);
        HashMap<String, String> headerMap = new HashMap<>();
        headerMap.put("SUPPORT_STREAM_CONTENT_FOR_SDK", "true");
        restfulParametes.setHeaderMap(headerMap);
        RestfulResponse restfulResponse = RestUtil.sendRestRequest(context.getHttpServletRequest(),
            RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST, LLM_URL, restfulParametes, null);

        if (restfulResponse.getStatus() == 424) {
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
        }
        if (!HttpStatus.isSuccess(restfulResponse.getStatus())) {
            String responseContent = restfulResponse.getResponseContent();
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails, code is {}, body is {}", restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
        }

        BlockedIterator<String> blockedIterator = new BlockedIterator<>();
        THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_FOR_LLM.execute(() -> {
            try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(restfulResponse.getDataStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                String line;
                int respLen = 0;
                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                    respLen += line.length();
                    if (!line.startsWith("data: ")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    ChatCompletionsRsp chatCompletionsRsp = JSON.parseObject(line.substring(6),
                        ChatCompletionsRsp.class);
                    ChatCompletionsRsp.ChoicesDTO choicesDTO = chatCompletionsRsp.getChoices().get(0);
                    blockedIterator.add(choicesDTO.getDelta().getContent());
                    if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(choicesDTO.getFinishReason())) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable e) {
                log.error("query fail", e);
                blockedIterator.setException(new NoSuchElementException(e.getMessage()));
            } finally {
                blockedIterator.end("");
            }
        });
        return blockedIterator;
    }
```

```java
package com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.llm;

import com.huawei.bsp.log.OssLog;
import com.huawei.bsp.log.OssLogFactory;
import com.huawei.bsp.remoteservice.exception.ServiceException;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.common.HttpContext;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.util.restclient.RestfulOptions;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.util.restclient.RestfulParametes;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.util.restclient.RestfulResponse;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.llm.api.BlockedIterator;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.llm.dto.ChatCompletionResponse;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.llm.dto.ChatCompletionsReq;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.llm.dto.ChatCompletionsRsp;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.llm.dto.ChatJobQuestion;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.exception.LLMFixException;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.exception.SafeGuardrailException;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.util.rest.RestConstant;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.util.rest.RestUtil;

import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSON;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.eclipse.jetty.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.CustomizableThreadFactory;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor;

/**
 * 大模型调用的实现类
 *
 * @since 2024-09-14
 */
@Slf4j
public class LlmInvokeApi {
    private static final OssLog LOGGER = OssLogFactory.getLogger(LlmInvokeApi.class);

    private static final ThreadPoolExecutor THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_FOR_LLM = new ThreadPoolExecutor(10, 20, 60L,
        java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, new java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<>(50),
        new CustomizableThreadFactory("Invoke-LLM-"));

    private static final String LLM_URL = "/rest/naie/aiagentcore/v1/completions";

    private static final String AIAGENTCORE_MODEL = "netmo-default";

    private static final String QWEN_MODEL = "qwen";

    private static final String DS_MODEL = "deepseek";

    private static final String THINK_BLOCK = "</think>";

    private static final int TIMEOUT = 10 * 60 * 1000;

    public static String invokeLlm(HttpContext context, String question)
        throws ServiceException {
        return invokeLlm(context, AIAGENTCORE_MODEL, question, null);
    }

    public static String invokeLlmWithoutContext(String question)
        throws ServiceException {
        return invokeLlm(null, AIAGENTCORE_MODEL, question, null);
    }

    public static String invokeLlm(HttpContext context, String model, String question, String systemPrompt)
        throws ServiceException {
        LOGGER.info("invoke LLM: {}, param is {}, question {}, system prompt {}", model, context, question, systemPrompt);
        ChatCompletionsReq chatCompletionsReq = new ChatCompletionsReq();
        chatCompletionsReq.setStream(Boolean.FALSE);
        chatCompletionsReq.setModel(model);
        List<ChatJobQuestion> chatJobQuestionList = new ArrayList<>(List.of(new ChatJobQuestion("user", question)));
        if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(systemPrompt)) {
            chatJobQuestionList.addFirst(new ChatJobQuestion("system", systemPrompt));
        }
        chatCompletionsReq.setMessages(chatJobQuestionList);
        String param = JSON.toJSONString(chatCompletionsReq);
        RestfulParametes restfulParametes = new RestfulParametes();
        restfulParametes.setRawData(param);
        LOGGER.info("param: {}", param);
        RestfulOptions options = new RestfulOptions();
        options.setRestTimeout(TIMEOUT);
        RestfulResponse restfulResponse;
        if (context == null) {
            restfulResponse =
                RestUtil.sendRestRequest(RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST, LLM_URL, restfulParametes, options);
        } else {
            restfulResponse = RestUtil.sendRestRequest(context.getHttpServletRequest(),
                RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST,
                LLM_URL,
                restfulParametes,
                options);
        }

        // 424 表示大模型大模型服务触发熔断。
        if (restfulResponse.getStatus() == 424) {
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
        }
        if (!HttpStatus.isSuccess(restfulResponse.getStatus())) {
            String responseContent = restfulResponse.getResponseContent();
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails, code is {}, body is {}", restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
        }
        LOGGER.info("restfulResponse: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());

        String jsonDataFromResponse = extractJsonDataFromResponse(restfulResponse.getResponseContent());

        ChatCompletionResponse chatCompletionsRsp = JSON.parseObject(jsonDataFromResponse,
            ChatCompletionResponse.class);
        LOGGER.info("chatCompletionsRsp is {}", chatCompletionsRsp);

        String content = chatCompletionsRsp.getChoices().getFirst().getMessage().getContent();
        // 处理思考内容
        int firstIndex = content.indexOf(THINK_BLOCK);
        if (firstIndex < 0) {
            LOGGER.info("first index less than 0");
            return content;
        }
        return content.substring(firstIndex + THINK_BLOCK.length()).trim();
    }

    public static String extractJsonDataFromResponse(String rawResponse) {
        if (rawResponse == null || rawResponse.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("rawResponse is null");
        }

        String jsonData = null;
        String[] lines = rawResponse.split("\n");
        for (String line : lines) {
            if (line.startsWith("data:")) {
                jsonData = line.substring(5);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (jsonData == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to parse the returned content, data field is missing.");
        }

        return jsonData;
    }

    public static Iterator<String> invokeLlmStream(HttpContext context, String question)
        throws ServiceException, SafeGuardrailException {
        return invokeLlmStream(context, AIAGENTCORE_MODEL, question);
    }

    public static Iterator<String> invokeLlmStream(HttpContext context, String model, String question)
        throws ServiceException {
        String param = JSON.toJSONString(new ChatCompletionsReq(true,
            model,
            Collections.singletonList(new ChatJobQuestion("user", question))));
        RestfulParametes restfulParametes = new RestfulParametes();
        restfulParametes.setRawData(param);
        HashMap<String, String> headerMap = new HashMap<>();
        headerMap.put("SUPPORT_STREAM_CONTENT_FOR_SDK", "true");
        restfulParametes.setHeaderMap(headerMap);
        RestfulResponse restfulResponse = RestUtil.sendRestRequest(context.getHttpServletRequest(),
            RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST, LLM_URL, restfulParametes, null);

        if (restfulResponse.getStatus() == 424) {
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
        }
        if (!HttpStatus.isSuccess(restfulResponse.getStatus())) {
            String responseContent = restfulResponse.getResponseContent();
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails, code is {}, body is {}", restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
        }

        BlockedIterator<String> blockedIterator = new BlockedIterator<>();
        THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_FOR_LLM.execute(() -> {
            try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(restfulResponse.getDataStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                String line;
                int respLen = 0;
                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                    respLen += line.length();
                    if (!line.startsWith("data: ")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    ChatCompletionsRsp chatCompletionsRsp = JSON.parseObject(line.substring(6),
                        ChatCompletionsRsp.class);
                    ChatCompletionsRsp.ChoicesDTO choicesDTO = chatCompletionsRsp.getChoices().get(0);
                    blockedIterator.add(choicesDTO.getDelta().getContent());
                    if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(choicesDTO.getFinishReason())) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable e) {
                log.error("query fail", e);
                blockedIterator.setException(new NoSuchElementException(e.getMessage()));
            } finally {
                blockedIterator.end("");
            }
        });
        return blockedIterator;
    }
}
```

```java
@Slf4j
public class LlmInvokeApi {

    /**
     * 上报进度信息的线程池
     */
    private static final ThreadPoolExecutor THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_FOR_LLM = new ThreadPoolExecutor(10, 20, 60L,
        java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, new java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<>(50),
        new CustomizableThreadFactory("Invoke-LLM-"));

    private static final String LLM_URL = "/rest/naie/aiagentcore/v1/completions";

    private static final String AIAGENTCORE_MODEL = "netmo-default";

    private static final String QWEN_MODEL = "qwen";

    private static final int TIMEOUT = 10 * 60 * 1000;

    /**
     * 非流式调用大模型
     *
     * @param context 上下文
     * @param question 问题

     * @throws ServiceException 异常

    /**
     * 非流式调用大模型
     *
     * @param context 上下文
     * @param model 模型名
     * @param question 问题
     * @param systemPrompt 系统提示词
     * @return 模型返回
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public static String invokeLlm(HttpContext context, String model, String question, String systemPrompt)
        throws ServiceException {
        LOGGER.info("invoke LLM: {}, param is {}, question {}, system prompt {}", model, context, question, systemPrompt);
        ChatCompletionsReq chatCompletionsReq = new ChatCompletionsReq();
        chatCompletionsReq.setStream(Boolean.FALSE);
        chatCompletionsReq.setModel(model);
        List<ChatJobQuestion> chatJobQuestionList = new ArrayList<>(List.of(new ChatJobQuestion("user", question)));
        if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(systemPrompt)) {
            chatJobQuestionList.addFirst(new ChatJobQuestion("system", systemPrompt));
        }
        chatCompletionsReq.setMessages(chatJobQuestionList);
        String param = JSON.toJSONString(chatCompletionsReq);
        RestfulParametes restfulParametes = new RestfulParametes();
        restfulParametes.setRawData(param);
        LOGGER.info("param: {}", param);
        RestfulOptions options = new RestfulOptions();
        options.setRestTimeout(TIMEOUT);
        RestfulResponse restfulResponse;
        if (context == null) {
            restfulResponse =
                RestUtil.sendRestRequest(RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST, LLM_URL, restfulParametes, options);
        } else {
            restfulResponse = RestUtil.sendRestRequest(context.getHttpServletRequest(),
                RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST,
                LLM_URL,
                restfulParametes,
                options);
        }

        // 424 表示大模型大模型服务触发熔断。
        if (restfulResponse.getStatus() == 424) {
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
        }
        if (!HttpStatus.isSuccess(restfulResponse.getStatus())) {
            // 413 情况标识问题过长
            String responseContent = restfulResponse.getResponseContent();
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails, code is {}, body is {}", restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
        }
        LOGGER.info("restfulResponse: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());

        String jsonDataFromResponse = extractJsonDataFromResponse(restfulResponse.getResponseContent());

        ChatCompletionResponse chatCompletionsRsp = JSON.parseObject(jsonDataFromResponse,
            ChatCompletionResponse.class);
        LOGGER.info("chatCompletionsRsp is {}", chatCompletionsRsp);

        String content = chatCompletionsRsp.getChoices().getFirst().getMessage().getContent();
        // 处理思考内容
        int firstIndex = content.indexOf(THINK_BLOCK);
        if (firstIndex < 0) {
            LOGGER.info("first index less than 0");
            return content;
        }
        return content.substring(firstIndex + THINK_BLOCK.length()).trim();
    }

    /**
     * 从原始响应内容中提取data字段的JSON数据
     *
     * @param rawResponse 原始响应内容，格式如：id:200 OK\ndata:{"id":"123"...}\n\n
     * @return data字段后的JSON字符串
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException 当无法找到data字段时抛出
     */
    public static String extractJsonDataFromResponse(String rawResponse) {
        if (rawResponse == null || rawResponse.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("rawResponse is null");
        }

        String jsonData = null;
        String[] lines = rawResponse.split("\n");
        for (String line : lines) {
            if (line.startsWith("data:")) {
                jsonData = line.substring(5); // 去掉 "data:" 前缀
                break;
            }
        }

        if (jsonData == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to parse the returned content, data field is missing.");
        }

        return jsonData;
    }

     *

     * @throws ServiceException ServiceException

    public static Iterator<String> invokeLlmStream(HttpContext context, String question)
        throws ServiceException, SafeGuardrailException {

    /**

     *
     * @param context 上下文
     * @param model 模型名
     * @param question 问题
     * @return Iterator<String>
     * @throws ServiceException ServiceException
     */
    public static Iterator<String> invokeLlmStream(HttpContext context, String model, String question)
        throws ServiceException {
        String param = JSON.toJSONString(new ChatCompletionsReq(true,
            model,
            Collections.singletonList(new ChatJobQuestion("user", question))));
        RestfulParametes restfulParametes = new RestfulParametes();
        restfulParametes.setRawData(param);
        HashMap<String, String> headerMap = new HashMap<>();
        headerMap.put("SUPPORT_STREAM_CONTENT_FOR_SDK", "true");
        restfulParametes.setHeaderMap(headerMap);
        RestfulResponse restfulResponse = RestUtil.sendRestRequest(context.getHttpServletRequest(),
            RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST, LLM_URL, restfulParametes, null);

        // 424 表示大模型大模型服务触发熔断。
        if (restfulResponse.getStatus() == 424) {
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails: {}", restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), restfulResponse.getResponseContent());
        }
        if (!HttpStatus.isSuccess(restfulResponse.getStatus())) {
            // 413 情况标识问题过长
            String responseContent = restfulResponse.getResponseContent();
            LOGGER.error("invoke LLM fails, code is {}, body is {}", restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
            throw new LLMFixException(restfulResponse.getStatus(), responseContent);
        }

        BlockedIterator<String> blockedIterator = new BlockedIterator<>();
        THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_FOR_LLM.execute(() -> {
            try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(restfulResponse.getDataStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                String line;
                int respLen = 0;
                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                    respLen += line.length();
                    if (!line.startsWith("data: ")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    ChatCompletionsRsp chatCompletionsRsp = JSON.parseObject(line.substring(6),
                        ChatCompletionsRsp.class);
                    ChatCompletionsRsp.ChoicesDTO choicesDTO = chatCompletionsRsp.getChoices().get(0);
                    blockedIterator.add(choicesDTO.getDelta().getContent());
                    if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(choicesDTO.getFinishReason())) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable e) {
                log.error("query fail", e);
                blockedIterator.setException(new NoSuchElementException(e.getMessage()));
            } finally {
                blockedIterator.end("");
            }
        });
        return blockedIterator;
    }
}
```
